```pddl
(define (problem flood-rescue-medium-04)
  (:domain flood-rescue)
  (:requirements :strips :typing :negative-preconditions :action-costs)

  (:objects
    car1 car2 - car
    myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple galchhi-village naukunda-village thakre-village dhunche-farm bidur-school shivapuri-care-home - location
    n1 n2 n3 n4 n5 n6 n7 - level)

  (:init
    (= (total-cost) 0)

    ;; Roads (both directions), with travel times
    (road galchhi-village naukunda-village)
    (road naukunda-village galchhi-village)
    (= (travel-time galchhi-village naukunda-village) 21)
    (= (travel-time naukunda-village galchhi-village) 21)

    (road myagang-shelter thakre-village)
    (road thakre-village myagang-shelter)
    (= (travel-time myagang-shelter thakre-village) 10)
    (= (travel-time thakre-village myagang-shelter) 10)

    (road galchhi-village shivapuri-care-home)
    (road shivapuri-care-home galchhi-village)
    (damaged galchhi-village shivapuri-care-home)
    (damaged shivapuri-care-home galchhi-village)
    (= (travel-time galchhi-village shivapuri-care-home) 10)
    (= (travel-time shivapuri-care-home galchhi-village) 10)

    (road dhunche-farm naukunda-village)
    (road naukunda-village dhunche-farm)
    (= (travel-time dhunche-farm naukunda-village) 21)
    (= (travel-time naukunda-village dhunche-farm) 21)

    (road dhunche-farm bidur-school)
    (road bidur-school dhunche-farm)
    (= (travel-time dhunche-farm bidur-school) 12)
    (= (travel-time bidur-school dhunche-farm) 12)

    (road galchhi-village bidur-school)
    (road bidur-school galchhi-village)
    (damaged galchhi-village bidur-school)
    (damaged bidur-school galchhi-village)
    (= (travel-time galchhi-village bidur-school) 25)
    (= (travel-time bidur-school galchhi-village) 25)

    (road myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple)
    (road nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter)
    (= (travel-time myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple) 31)
    (= (travel-time nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter) 31)

    (road shivapuri-care-home bidur-school)
    (road bidur-school shivapuri-care-home)
    (= (travel-time shivapuri-care-home bidur-school) 20)
    (= (travel-time bidur-school shivapuri-care-home) 20)

    (road dhunche-farm shivapuri-care-home)
    (road shivapuri-care-home dhunche-farm)
    (damaged dhunche-farm shivapuri-care-home)
    (damaged shivapuri-care-home dhunche-farm)
    (= (travel-time dhunche-farm shivapuri-care-home) 26)
    (= (travel-time shivapuri-care-home dhunche-farm) 26)

    (road nilkantha-temple naukunda-village)
    (road naukunda-village nilkantha-temple)
    (= (travel-time nilkantha-temple naukunda-village) 55)
    (= (travel-time naukunda-village nilkantha-temple) 55)

    ;; Evacuation points
    (evac-point myagang-shelter)

    ;; Cars
    (car-at car1 myagang-shelter)
    (car-at car2 myagang-shelter)
    (free-seats car1 n4)
    (free-seats car2 n4)
    (carrying car1 injured n0)
    (carrying car1 child n0)
    (carrying car1 elderly n0)
    (carrying car1 adult n0)
    (carrying car2 injured n0)
    (carrying car2 child n0)
    (carrying car2 elderly n0)
    (carrying car2 adult n0)

    ;; People waiting
    (waiting galchhi-village child n3)
    (waiting galchhi-village injured n1)
    (waiting nilkantha-temple adult n7)
    (waiting bidur-school child n3)
    (waiting shivapuri-care-home elderly n4)

    ;; Arithmetic relations: a + b = c
    (sum n0 n0 n0)
    (sum n0 n1 n1) (sum n1 n0 n1)
    (sum n0 n2 n2) (sum n1 n1 n2) (sum n2 n0 n2)
    (sum n0 n3 n3) (sum n1 n2 n3) (sum n2 n1 n3) (sum n3 n0 n3)
    (sum n0 n4 n4) (sum n1 n3 n4) (sum n2 n2 n4) (sum n3 n1 n4) (sum n4 n0 n4)
    (sum n0 n5 n5) (sum n1 n4 n5) (sum n2 n3 n5) (sum n3 n2 n5) (sum n4 n1 n5) (sum n5 n0 n5)
    (sum n0 n6 n6) (sum n1 n5 n6) (sum n2 n4 n6) (sum n3 n3 n6) (sum n4 n2 n6) (sum n5 n1 n6) (sum n6 n0 n6)
    (sum n0 n7 n7) (sum n1 n6 n7) (sum n2 n5 n7) (sum n3 n4 n7) (sum n4 n3 n7) (sum n5 n2 n7) (sum n6 n1 n7) (sum n7 n0 n7)

    ;; Positive levels
    (positive n1) (positive n2) (positive n3) (positive n4)
    (positive n5) (positive n6) (positive n7)

    ;; Deferral penalties (per-person penalty x N)
    (= (defer-cost injured n1) 80)
    (= (defer-cost injured n2) 160)
    (= (defer-cost injured n3) 240)
    (= (defer-cost injured n4) 320)
    (= (defer-cost injured n5) 400)
    (= (defer-cost injured n6) 480)
    (= (defer-cost injured n7) 560)

    (= (defer-cost child n1) 60)
    (= (defer-cost child n2) 120)
    (= (defer-cost child n3) 180)
    (= (defer-cost child n4) 240)
    (= (defer-cost child n5) 300)
    (= (defer-cost child n6) 360)
    (= (defer-cost child n7) 420)

    (= (defer-cost elderly n1) 50)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n2) 100)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n3) 150)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n4) 200)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n5) 250)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n6) 300)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n7) 350)

    (= (defer-cost adult n1) 20)
    (= (defer-cost adult n2) 40)
    (= (defer-cost adult n3) 60)
    (= (defer-cost adult n4) 80)
    (= (defer-cost adult n5) 100)
    (= (defer-cost adult n6) 120)
    (= (defer-cost adult n7) 140)
  )

  (:goal (and
    ;; Everyone waiting is either rescued or deferred
    (waiting galchhi-village child n0)
    (waiting galchhi-village injured n0)
    (waiting nilkantha-temple adult n0)
    (waiting bidur-school child n0)
    (waiting shivapuri-care-home elderly n0)

    ;; Cars are empty at the end
    (carrying car1 injured n0)
    (carrying car1 child n0)
    (carrying car1 elderly n0)
    (carrying car1 adult n0)
    (carrying car2 injured n0)
    (carrying car2 child n0)
    (carrying car2 elderly n0)
    (carrying car2 adult n0)
  ))

  (:metric minimize (total-cost))
)
```
